detail.sDescription: The Nekrova ISSR is a fast, mobile sniper rifle that is whisper quiet, allowing you to kill targets efficiently and quickly without giving away your position.

eFnMod_0.sDescription:
Barrel Modification -
A Suppressor and Speciality rounds dampen the sound and muzzle flare and remove all tracers.  The special rounds slightly reduces range compared to the standard HVR model.

eAmmoCategory.sDescription: High performance ammunition for use with high-velocity rifles.
